relations.subject: Stephen Addiss
relations.evidence: He later earned a master's degree and a doctorate in East Asian art history at the University of Michigan, completing his PhD in 1977 with his dissertation on Japanese painter Uragami Gyokudo.

relations.subject: Stephen Addiss
relations.evidence: Addiss taught at the University of Kansas from 1977 to 1992

relations.subject: Stephen Addiss
relations.evidence: and then from 1992 at the University of Richmond. At Richmond, he held the Tucker-Boatwright Professorship in the Humanities until his retirement in 2013.

relations.subject: Stephen Addiss
relations.evidence: Addiss was also an adjunct curator at the New Orleans Museum of Art from 1978 to 1986

relations.evidence: and served as honorary curator of the American Haiku Archives at the California State Library, 2009-2010.

relations.subject: Stephen Addiss
